name: academic-figure-skills
description: Two academic figure skills: academic-figure-workflow designs style, palette, and prompts, compiles FigureSpec, and handles native rendering, visual audit, and targeted revision; academic-figure-analyzer turns repositories, papers, drafts, and reference figures into SemanticArchitecture, FigurePlan, and ReferenceAnalysis.
author: Azhi-ss

skills.name: Academic Figure Workflow
skills.description: Design evidence-grounded academic figures and construct, diagnose, or revise prompts; semantic palettes, reference-led styles, and FigureSpec v1. Plan, generate, inspect, and refine figures with conditional review and native image-tool routing. Repository, paper, draft, or reference-figure inputs are analyzed by academic-figure-analyzer first. Can replace AI-rendered text with editable PowerPoint text boxes.
trigger_phrases: 帮我从仓库到配图走一遍
which skill should I use first
把 AI 图里的文字做成可编辑 PPTX
editable text on an AI figure

skills.name: Academic Figure Analyzer
skills.description: Evidence-backed analysis of repositories, paper drafts, and reference figures into SemanticArchitecture@1, FigurePlan@1, and ReferenceAnalysis@1, without writing prompts or generating images.
